card.name: 焔弾
card.file: C:\Users\beron\OneDrive\Documents\カードゲーム作成\デッキ\アグロリーゼ\カード一覧\07_焔弾.md

look.外見: リーゼが撃っている。16歳の少女で、少し傷んだポニーテールの緋色の髪、鋭い琥珀色の瞳。実用的な革の装備の上に焦げた黒と深紅のマントを羽織り、下はスカート。剥き出しの前腕に古い火傷の痕。据わった鋭い目つき。
look.情景: リーゼが片手を前へ突き出し、圧縮された白熱の炎の球を砲弾のように撃ち出す。背後の煙に衝撃波の輪が穿たれる。炎の球が画面でいちばん明るく、リーゼは撃つ側として画面に入る。
look.背景: 燃え始めた町。炎が背後で上がっている。

lookRules: 光源は炎。 基調は熾火の橙、溶けた赤、煤の黒。差し色に熱で白く飛んだ光。冷たい色は使わない。夜と火事をテーマ。
力の見た目は炎と火の粉で統一する。 力が働いているところには、舞う火の粉と流れる灰が必ず出る。魔法陣や記号は使わない。
町が焼けていく順に暗くする。 1〜2コスト帯はまだ人が住んでいる町の明るい火。3〜4コスト帯は燃え始めた町。5コスト以上は焼け落ちた黒い夜で、炎だけが光る。
火傷で描き分ける。 イグナの人間は肌のどこかに古い火傷の痕がある。髪は緋色から赤茶、瞳は琥珀色。ベルゼとヴェルドは体そのものが火に変わりかけている。

【画面の使い方】絵は画面の端から端まで埋める。絵自身の縁取り・余白・周辺減光・台紙は描かない。どの端からも5%以内に重要なものを置かない。画面の下4分の1には顔や主役を置かず、静かな背景のままにする（あとで効果テキストが重なる領域だが、その帯や板を絵の中に描いてはいけない）。

【構図】やや縦長の、現象そのもののイラスト。基本的に人物が技を撃っていたり、その技自体が中心になっている。効果そのものが主役で、広がりのある劇的な一瞬として捉える。エネルギーの中心は画面の上半分に置く。

Art Style: Japanese anime cel shading style. Clean cel shading layered with soft gradients. Confident, crisp line art with thick main outlines and fine inner detail lines. Large eyes with carefully detailed irises and highlights. Minimal, clean skin shadows, and glossy highlights on the hair. Vivid, highly saturated colors. Expressive, readable face. Finished quality suitable for mobile game key art.
Canvas Usage: Fill the canvas completely from edge to edge. Do not depict borders, margins, vignetting, or mount paper on the artwork itself. Keep all important elements at least 5% away from every edge. Do not place faces or main subjects in the bottom quarter of the canvas, keeping it as a quiet background (this area is reserved for overlay text later, but do not draw any banners, ribbons, or plates in the image).
Excluded Elements: Do not include text, alphabet letters, numbers, subtitles, signatures, watermarks, or logos. Do not include card frames, borders, UI elements, or status icons. Do not draw banners, ribbons, or semi-transparent plates intended for text placement. No speech bubbles, manga panels, collages, or split screens. Do not arrange the same character in multiple poses like a character design sheet.
Appearance: Riese is shooting. A 16-year-old girl with slightly damaged scarlet hair in a ponytail and sharp amber eyes. Wearing practical leather gear with a scorched black and deep crimson cloak over it, and a skirt below. Old burn scars on her bare forearms. A steady, piercing gaze.
Scene: Riese thrusts one hand forward, shooting a compressed sphere of incandescent flame like a cannonball. A shockwave ring pierces through the smoke behind it. The ball of flame is the brightest element in the frame, with Riese visible as the caster.
Background: A town beginning to burn. Flames rising in the background.
Shared Deck Visuals: The light source is fire. Base tones are ember orange, molten red, and soot black, accented by blown-out white heat light. Do not use cool colors. Night and fire theme. The manifestation of power is unified as flames and sparks. Wherever power is active, dancing sparks and drifting ash must appear. Do not use magic circles or symbols. Darkened in order of the town burning down: 1-2 cost tier is bright fire in a town where people still live; 3-4 cost tier is a town beginning to burn; 5+ cost tier is a burnt-down black night where only flames glow. Distinguished by burn scars. People of Igna have old burn scars somewhere on their skin, scarlet to reddish-brown hair, and amber eyes. Belze and Veld have bodies that are themselves beginning to turn into fire.
Composition: Slightly vertical illustration focused on the phenomenon itself. Basically shows a character firing a technique, with the technique itself at the center. The effect itself is the main subject, captured as an expansive, dramatic moment. The center of energy is placed in the upper half of the frame.
